summary: Improve indicator tracking, data checks and evaluation reporting with practical M&E exercises. Explore the course and review its outline.
lede: Monitoring and evaluation connects programme activities to evidence for decisions by tracking performance and assessing results. For M&E officers, programme teams and project leads, this training develops practical skills in applying a Theory of Change, refining indicators, checking data quality and analysing progress in Excel. Participants also practise framing evaluation questions and reporting findings with clear actions, while advanced evaluation designs and digital reporting workflows receive only an introduction.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for programme results, monitoring records, evaluation evidence or the reporting decisions that depend on them.
audience: Programme Managers using performance evidence to adjust
modules: Theory of Change and Results Pathways
prerequisites: Working familiarity with project or programme activities and basic monitoring reports is useful. Bring a laptop with Excel installed and use anonymized records or sample values for spreadsheet exercises. No coding is required.
